description:
Get Reactome pathways associated with a gene.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table target_pathways — one record = one Reactome pathway annotation of one gene.
Key: id, pathways[].pathwayId, pathways[].topLevelTerm.
Arguments: target_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by pathways[].pathwayId asc (verified by the harness); one row = one item (one Reactome pathway annotation of one gene); `_vbt.total` counts items; `_vbt.grains.membership` counts memberships; `_vbt.grains.gene` counts genes; `_vbt.grains.pathway` counts pathways.
topLevelTerm keeps one value of reactome_pathway; records under several are missed.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Lowest-level Reactome annotations, not propagated to every ancestor; a gene missing from a pathway is unannotated there.
topLevelTerm is a lossy single label (a pathway can sit under several top-level pathways); the exact top-level ancestors come from pathway.get_pathway_info or data._expand (direction ancestors) on the Reactome hierarchy.

target_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
